newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Lippo hospital unit to list on Surabaya exchange.
newsitem.headline: Lippo hospital unit to list on Surabaya exchange.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Siloam Gleneagles Health Care, a unit of the Lippo Group conglomerate, said on Tuesday it planned to list a 32 percent stake on the Surabaya stock exchange.
"Gleneagles expects to lists its shares on the Surabaya stock exchange in March this year," a Lippo Group official said.
He said it would use the proceeds from the offering expected to be around $59 million to expand the firm's hospital network into other cities in Indonesia.
He said the offering period would be held later this month.
Gleneagles shareholders include PT Lippo Land Development and Singapore firms Parkway Holdings Ltd and Gleneagles Development Pte Ltd, the official said.
Further details were not immediately available.
